You'll find the right define in the 66 * first lines of the corresponding unit. 67 * 68 * Other (mixed) configuration switches are listed here: 69 * ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_COMPRESSED_X 70 * - Disable support for compressed X files (zip) 71 * ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_COMPRESSED_BLEND 72 * - Disable support for compressed Blender files (zip) 73 * ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_COMPRESSED_IFC 74 * - Disable support for IFCZIP files (unzip) 75 */ 77 78 #ifndef ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_COMPRESSED_X 79 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_NEED_Z_INFLATE 80 #endif 81 82 #ifndef ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_COMPRESSED_BLEND 83 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_NEED_Z_INFLATE 84 #endif 85 86 #ifndef ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_COMPRESSED_IFC 87 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_NEED_Z_INFLATE 88 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_NEED_UNZIP 89 #endif 90 91 #ifndef ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_Q3BSP_IMPORTER 92 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_NEED_Z_INFLATE 93 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_NEED_UNZIP 94 #endif 95 96 // We need those constants, workaround for any platforms where nobody defined them yet 97 #if (!defined SIZE_MAX) 98 #define SIZE_MAX (~((size_t)0)) 99 #endif 100 101 /*#if (!defined UINT_MAX) 102 #define UINT_MAX (~((unsigned int)0)) 103 #endif*/ 104 106 /* Define ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_XX_PROCESS to disable a specific 107 * post processing step. This is the current list of process names ('XX'): 108 * CALCTANGENTS 109 * JOINVERTICES 110 * TRIANGULATE 111 * DROPFACENORMALS 112 * GENFACENORMALS 113 * GENVERTEXNORMALS 114 * REMOVEVC 115 * SPLITLARGEMESHES 116 * PRETRANSFORMVERTICES 117 * LIMITBONEWEIGHTS 118 * VALIDATEDS 119 * IMPROVECACHELOCALITY 120 * FIXINFACINGNORMALS 121 * REMOVE_REDUNDANTMATERIALS 122 * OPTIMIZEGRAPH 123 * SORTBYPTYPE 124 * FINDINVALIDDATA 125 * TRANSFORMTEXCOORDS 126 * GENUVCOORDS 127 * ENTITYMESHBUILDER 128 * EMBEDTEXTURES 129 * MAKELEFTHANDED 130 * FLIPUVS 131 * FLIPWINDINGORDER 132 * OPTIMIZEMESHES 133 * OPTIMIZEANIMS 134 * OPTIMIZEGRAPH 135 * GENENTITYMESHES 136 * FIXTEXTUREPATHS 137 * GENBOUNDINGBOXES */ 139 140 #ifdef _WIN32 141 #undef ASSIMP_API 143 /* Define 'ASSIMP_BUILD_DLL_EXPORT' to build a DLL of the library */ 145 #ifdef ASSIMP_BUILD_DLL_EXPORT 146 #define ASSIMP_API __declspec(dllexport) 147 #define ASSIMP_API_WINONLY __declspec(dllexport) 148 150 /* Define 'ASSIMP_DLL' before including Assimp to link to ASSIMP in 151 * an external DLL under Windows. Default is static linkage. */ 153 #elif (defined ASSIMP_DLL) 154 #define ASSIMP_API __declspec(dllimport) 155 #define ASSIMP_API_WINONLY __declspec(dllimport) 156 #else 157 #define ASSIMP_API 158 #define ASSIMP_API_WINONLY 159 #endif 160 #elif defined(SWIG) 161 /* Do nothing, the relevant defines are all in AssimpSwigPort.i */ 162 #else 163 #define ASSIMP_API __attribute__((visibility("default"))) 164 #define ASSIMP_API_WINONLY 165 #endif // _WIN32 166 167 #ifdef _MSC_VER 168 #pragma warning(disable : 4521 4512 4714 4127 4351 4510) 169 #ifdef ASSIMP_BUILD_DLL_EXPORT 170 #pragma warning(disable : 4251) 171 #endif 172 /* Force the compiler to inline a function, if possible */ 173 #define AI_FORCE_INLINE inline 174 175 /* Tells the compiler that a function never returns. Used in code analysis 176 * to skip dead paths (e.g. after an assertion evaluated to false). */ 177 #define AI_WONT_RETURN __declspec(noreturn) 178 #elif defined(SWIG) 179 /* Do nothing, the relevant defines are all in AssimpSwigPort.i */ 180 #else 181 #define AI_WONT_RETURN 182 #define AI_FORCE_INLINE inline 183 #endif // (defined _MSC_VER) 184 185 #ifdef __GNUC__ 186 # define AI_WONT_RETURN_SUFFIX __attribute__((noreturn)) 187 #else 188 # define AI_WONT_RETURN_SUFFIX 189 #endif // (defined __clang__) 190 191 #ifdef __cplusplus 192 /* No explicit 'struct' and 'enum' tags for C++, this keeps showing up 193 * in doxydocs. 194 */ 195 #define C_STRUCT 196 #define C_ENUM 197 #else 199 /* To build the documentation, make sure ASSIMP_DOXYGEN_BUILD 200 * is defined by Doxygen's preprocessor. The corresponding 201 * entries in the DOXYFILE are: */ 203 #if 0 204 ENABLE_PREPROCESSING = YES 205 MACRO_EXPANSION = YES 206 EXPAND_ONLY_PREDEF = YES 207 SEARCH_INCLUDES = YES 208 INCLUDE_PATH = 209 INCLUDE_FILE_PATTERNS = 210 PREDEFINED = ASSIMP_DOXYGEN_BUILD=1 211 EXPAND_AS_DEFINED = C_STRUCT C_ENUM 212 SKIP_FUNCTION_MACROS = YES 213 #endif 215 /* Doxygen gets confused if we use c-struct typedefs to avoid 216 * the explicit 'struct' notation. This trick here has the same 217 * effect as the TYPEDEF_HIDES_STRUCT option, but we don't need 218 * to typedef all structs/enums. */ 220 #if (defined ASSIMP_DOXYGEN_BUILD) 221 #define C_STRUCT 222 #define C_ENUM 223 #else 224 #define C_STRUCT struct 225 #define C_ENUM enum 226 #endif 227 #endif 228 229 #if (defined(__BORLANDC__) || defined(__BCPLUSPLUS__)) 230 #error Currently, Borland is unsupported. Feel free to port Assimp. 231 #endif 232 234 /* Define ASSIMP_BUILD_SINGLETHREADED to compile assimp 235 * without threading support. The library doesn't utilize 236 * threads then and is itself not threadsafe. */ 238 #ifndef ASSIMP_BUILD_SINGLETHREADED 239 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_SINGLETHREADED 240 #endif 241 242 #if defined(_DEBUG) || !defined(NDEBUG) 243 #define ASSIMP_BUILD_DEBUG 244 #endif 245 247 /* Define ASSIMP_DOUBLE_PRECISION to compile assimp 248 * with double precision support (64-bit). */ 250 251 #ifdef ASSIMP_DOUBLE_PRECISION 252 typedef double ai_real; 253 typedef signed long long int ai_int; 254 typedef unsigned long long int ai_uint; 255 #ifndef ASSIMP_AI_REAL_TEXT_PRECISION 256 #define ASSIMP_AI_REAL_TEXT_PRECISION 17 257 #endif // ASSIMP_AI_REAL_TEXT_PRECISION 258 #else // ASSIMP_DOUBLE_PRECISION 259 typedef float ai_real; 260 typedef signed int ai_int; 261 typedef unsigned int ai_uint; 262 #ifndef ASSIMP_AI_REAL_TEXT_PRECISION 263 #define ASSIMP_AI_REAL_TEXT_PRECISION 9 264 #endif // ASSIMP_AI_REAL_TEXT_PRECISION 265 #endif // ASSIMP_DOUBLE_PRECISION 266 268 /* Useful constants */ 270 271 /* This is PI. Hi PI. */ 272 #define AI_MATH_PI (3.141592653589793238462643383279) 273 #define AI_MATH_TWO_PI (AI_MATH_PI * 2.0) 274 #define AI_MATH_HALF_PI (AI_MATH_PI * 0.5) 275 276 /* And this is to avoid endless casts to float */ 277 #define AI_MATH_PI_F (3.1415926538f) 278 #define AI_MATH_TWO_PI_F (AI_MATH_PI_F * 2.0f) 279 #define AI_MATH_HALF_PI_F (AI_MATH_PI_F * 0.5f) 280 281 /* Tiny macro to convert from radians to degrees and back */ 282 #define AI_DEG_TO_RAD(x) ((x) * (ai_real) 0.0174532925) 283 #define AI_RAD_TO_DEG(x) ((x) * (ai_real) 57.2957795) 284 285 /* Numerical limits */ 286 static const ai_real ai_epsilon = (ai_real) 1e-6; 287 288 /* Support for big-endian builds */ 289 #if defined(__BYTE_ORDER__) 290 #if (__BYTE_ORDER__ == __ORDER_BIG_ENDIAN__) 291 #if !defined(__BIG_ENDIAN__) 292 #define __BIG_ENDIAN__ 293 #endif 294 #else /* little endian */ 295 #if defined(__BIG_ENDIAN__) 296 #undef __BIG_ENDIAN__ 297 #endif 298 #endif 299 #endif 300 #if defined(__BIG_ENDIAN__) 301 #define AI_BUILD_BIG_ENDIAN 302 #endif 303 309 #define AI_MAX_ALLOC(type) ((256U * 1024 * 1024) / sizeof(type)) 310 311 #ifndef _MSC_VER 312 #if __cplusplus >= 201103L // C++11 313 #define AI_NO_EXCEPT noexcept 314 #else 315 #define AI_NO_EXCEPT 316 #endif 317 #else 318 #if (_MSC_VER >= 1915) 319 #define AI_NO_EXCEPT noexcept 320 #else 321 #define AI_NO_EXCEPT 322 #endif 323 #endif // _MSC_VER 324 328 #if (defined ASSIMP_BUILD_DEBUG) 329 #define AI_DEBUG_INVALIDATE_PTR(x) x = NULL; 330 #else 331 #define AI_DEBUG_INVALIDATE_PTR(x) 332 #endif 333 334 #define AI_COUNT_OF(X) (sizeof(X) / sizeof((X)[0])) 335 336 #endif // !!
